subject.title: [Feature]: openclaw notify — admin-scoped push to connected UI sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core `openclaw notify` admin broadcast surface now, fold it into the broader Control UI notification architecture, or leave shell-originated alerts to plugin/Web Push extension paths?
rationale: The feature is still missing, but it creates a new shell-to-UI admin capability and security boundary that source inspection alone cannot approve.

options.title: Design core notify contract
options.body: Keep this issue as the focused shell/admin notification tracker and require an explicit Gateway/UI/security contract before implementation.

options.title: Fold into broader notification architecture
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/20237 own the UI notification queue and update it to explicitly include shell/admin broadcast semantics.

options.title: Prefer plugin or Web Push extension
options.body: Decline a core command and document the supported plugin, Web Push, or external delivery path if maintainers do not want shell-originated UI interruption in core.

recommendation.title: Design core notify contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the focused shell/admin notification tracker and require an explicit Gateway/UI/security contract before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review context already routed this feature's product/security boundary to Peter, and the remaining decision is owner intent rather than a mechanical code edit.
